name: Pinky
species: brave, sporty village girl (about 8 years old)
personality: brave, bossy-but-kind leader, fastest runner in town, solves problems. FUNNY: rolls her eyes at the boys' silly plans, then does something even sillier herself; super-loud whistle that makes birds fall out of trees; catchphrase 'Leave it to Pinky!'
look: girl with warm brown skin, two bouncy black pigtails with red ribbons, pink frock with white polka dots, yellow leggings, white sneakers, star-shaped hair clip
